source.name: Synchronize
source.originalDescription: Each time Mew uses a move, Mew and nearby allies have their movement speed increased by 15% for 2s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Synchronize は 移動速度を上げる。

baseAction.notes: 直接ダメージと単純移動はbaseActionへ保存し、特殊効果件数には含めない。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Each time Mew uses a move, they gain a boost counter. A maximum of 3 boost counters can be stored. After 3 counters are stored (they have to be consumed within 8s or they disappear), Mew's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack that consumes all counters and launches a ball of psychic energy at an enemy. During the lock-on animation Mew can use moves. The further the ball travels, the more damage it deals (4% more damage per threshold, stacking additively). This ball pierces through wild Pokémon, but will stop traveling upon contact with the first enemy player.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ。

source.name: Electro Ball
source.originalDescription: Hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect and leaving them paralyzed (40% slow, 10% attack speed reduction) for 2s. This move deals more damage the lower the enemies' remaining HP is. Through Light Screen: Damage dealt and area-of-effect radius are increased.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Electro Ball は まひを付与する、移動速度を下げる、通常攻撃速度を下げる、与ダメージを変化させる、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する。

source.name: Coaching
source.originalDescription: Teleport to an ally, granting them a shield for 3s and increasing basic attack speed by 40% for 2s. If this move is used on an ally who hasn't been coached within 7s, the cooldown of this move is reduced by 90%. If this move is used on an ally who has been recently coached, this move goes on cooldown. The cooldown of Electro Ball, Solar Beam, and Surf is reduced by 1s each time this move is used.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Coaching は 通常攻撃速度を上げる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する。

source.name: Mystical Mirage
source.originalDescription: Mew becomes unstoppable and floats in the air for 1s, then becoming invincible and invisible for up to 6s until using an attack or move. A field is created around Mew for 5s This field travels with Mew. Mew and all allies within the area become stealthed for 4s. After the field expires, this move deals damage to enemies within the area-of-effect. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Mystical Mirage は 妨害無効になる、無敵になる、対象指定されない、またはステルス状態になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、フィールド・設置範囲を生成する。
